name: A Piece of Sweetness
source:
A Piece of Sweetness is a linear visual novel about a girl named Emily that is a tourist in an unknown town. She happens upon a little cafe called the Tea & Bakery where, over the course of five days, enjoys a variety of tea and sweets! 

The tea and sweets Emily enjoys plays out as a jigsaw puzzle for the player to solve before progressing in the story.

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/a-piece-of-sweetness]Itch.io[/url]]
